avis.texte: This is a great product! I was at Ulta Beauty looking for a moisturizer and there was a Dermologica Representative there and he suggested a serum. He gave me a couple of serums to try and the rest is history! I be love it!
This is a new staple in my skincare. Its feels SO moisturizing. I will never stop using this! My skin loves it.
I purchased many of the Dermalogica products for my 17-year-old granddaughter. Her skin looks beautiful.
Use this product every day under a Dermalogica moisturizer. It makes my skin dewy soft & radiant.
Absolutely love the Circular Hydration Serum, makes a big difference how my facial skin feels and looks!!
I love the texture of this serum and the fact that it has many benefits in one

I used the Dermalogica Virtual Assistant and so pleased with all recommendations, but particularly this serum! So refreshing to put on and settles into the skin really nicely - not tacky. Most importantly, I have found it extremely hydrating and has, I think, been the key product to help heal my extremely dry neck/jawline that spurred during my pregnancy.

avis.titre: Best serum out there for dry skin
avis.texte: I have tried so many different serums and products, wasted a lot of money. This is the best thing I have ever gotten for my dry, sensitive skin. I also have rosacia and this has significantly reduced my redness over the last couple months. I'm 52 for reference, dry, Extremely sensitive and dry skin. you won't regret it
Just started using this and it is awesome. My skin is very dry and it makes it glow. I love everything about this product.

This serum left my skin super hydrated. The moisturized feeling lasted well over 9 hours for me. Unfortunately, I returned it initially because I thought it was causing breakouts. I later realized that my new Tretinoin cream was the more likely culprit. I definitely plan to reorder soon and highly recommend this product!

Out of the few serums I've tried, this is my absolute go to. I get dry patches and during the winter this is a must. The serum is so smooth and it's melts into my skin. I use it with the dynamic recovery moisturizer
My skin loves this ! Indoor environments tend to dehydrate my skin. Circular Hydration absorbs and adds hydration to my skin immediately without being sticky or interfering with other products.

I absolutely love this product. sadly it's expensive. I combine a drop in my current moisturizer. When I go to church on Sunday, I have used this directly in a few places and live it so much! Doing it this way makes it last long. Love it! but expensive, but still love it, 😆
Very hydrating and helps with skin feeling smooth all day long. Especially essential during the dry cold months

This is an amazing product! It makes my skin so soft and smooth. It pairs well with my Trentinoin! This product keeps my skin from dying out. Great for aging women that wish to keep that glowing youthful appearance.
My skin stays moisturized and smooth all day long. Works perfectly under makeup and helps provide youthful glow all day

avis.titre: Bottle top loosens obstructing you from opening it
avis.texte: I have bought this product twice and use it day snd night for the last 5 months. I dont notice much of a difference in my skin… Both times , the blue top part of the bottle loosened up and makes it so that I cannot open the top of the bottle. I tried returning to Ulta since there was still I use product in it but they wouldn't help. I see now that other reviews said that too part of the bottle loosened for them as well. It's a shame as the product goes unused.

This is a great serum that I have re-bought multiple times now these past few years. It's easy to dispense, massages into my skin well, does not feel tacky when dry, makes me feel moisturized. Very happy with this and will continue to re-buy.
My skin looks so much better since I started using this serum. Keeps my skin hydrated without feeling heavy or greasy.

I have been using this for several years. This hydration booster is a game changer to hydrate skin without interfering with moisturizer or makeup. I use to have dry patches all the time and exfoliating did not help until i started using this. I faithful use am after vitamn c and evening before retinol.

I have been using this serum since it came out and I love it! I use it under my moisturizer prior to vitamin C serum. It definitely gives that glowy look. I was so excited to see Dermalogica came out with a 2oz bottle. It is more cost effective and will last longer than the 1oz. Will continue to buy!

First I think its important to disclose your age and skin type as your skin changes at different stages in life. I'm 39, and have dry skin. I picked this up along with several other dermalogica products and have been using them for 4 months. I wanted to use it for a while before reviewing. I see no positive or negative effects with this on my skin. It does feel a bit sticky. The metal component around the lid fell off after a week (I did have it in a travel bag in hot conditions so it probably loosened the glue holding it). The results vs the price were not worth it to me. I used as directed. I would recommend the milkfoliant and the moisturizer from dermalogica though.

I started using this about 4 months ago and it has transformed my skin! I use it with a few other products too but this is definitely what's giving my skin moisture and just makes it look better over all. It's a bit pricey but a little goes a long way

avis.titre: Will use in my routine forever
avis.texte: This instantly plumps and hydrates my skin. It also gives my skin a beautiful glow. I cant count how many times ive repurchased, it will forever be a staple in my routine.
Amazing serum, feels like nothing but really makes a difference on yoir skin

This circular hydration serum has been a wonderful addition to my daily routine. Especially during the dry, cold winter months, I have noticed that it is helping combat the struggle with keeping my skin hydrated. I am very averse to smells and this product is very neutral with no off-putting smell. I highly recommend this serum if you struggle with keeping your face hydrated.

The circular hydration serum seems to keep my face softer and more hydrated all day especially now in the dry winter months. I have combination skin and my cheeks tend to be drier. This serum is great for me for the winter months. Would definitely recommend this product to anyone with dry or aging skin!
This product goes on so smoothly! I really love it and will continue using it! I have been using it twice a day and so far my skin is really loving it!

So far this very cold winter weather has not had a chance to wreak havok with my skin, thanks to Dermalogica hydration serum! I use it under my moisturizer am and pm and it seems to be doing a great job of keeping my other wise dry skin on my face and neck hydrated.
I love this serum. I put it on every evening and in the winter especially my skin feels so balanced and hydrated.
I love this product! It soaks right into my skin and makes me feel refreshed without leaving my skin greasy.
Silky consistency. Super hydrating. An instant moisture boost.

avis.titre: Excellent quality and works very well
avis.texte: Although the directions say to use a dropper, I only need about 3 drops and it covers my entire face and neck. It feels clean and smooth and is great underneath my daily SPF moisturizer. I've noticed my skin is far less parched this winter since using the serum. Definitely will recommend.

My skin needed this! The consistency is lightweight and soaks into my skin effortlessly and leaves my skin hydrated and glowing! I was having dry, itchy patches on my face due to weather and this serum brought my skin new life... within one use, I could feel the difference and it left me hydrated all day. My skin is soothed, plump, and all dry patches are gone; such a relief. I'll use this as my base serum forever :)

My skin takes a real beating during winter - the cold dry air outside, and warm dry air inside, and this serum is the perfect protection against the dry elements. The relief my skin gets is superb. Like all Dermalogica products, this is another high quality product.

Dermalogica puts a lot of unnecessary fragrance oils in their products, their ingredient list is ridiculously long. I got so much irritation from their products (this serum being one of the products in my routine). I loved the feel of it and it felt hydrating but caused me so many tiny bumps and irritation which sucks because I really wanted to love this product.
This serum is a GAME CHANGER. I use this twice a day after cleaning and before moisturizing with a cream. Sits amazing under makeup.
You feel the hydration within a few days. I love this serum for the winter.

avis.titre: The one thing you need for great moisture to last all day.
avis.texte: I love this product. It provides the moisture I need to keep my face from drying out during 12 hour shifts at night. It's fragrance free, and super light. Great for sensitive skin like my own.
This serum is a game changer!! I love it so much! My skin is so much happier!

avis.titre: The first serum my skin had adored!
avis.texte: I have sensitive, combo, rosacea skin. The journey of finding a serum to combat these equally has been hard/tiring. I'm almost 29 and my skin has stared to mature differently. This stuff helps give some bounce and moisture in my face! Fine lines are starting to fade a bit after a month. Even after the first use my coworker noticed the glow to my skin. It's pricey but worth it!!
Gentle and effective on my sensitive mature skin. Scent is pleasant and mild. Not greasy actually feels good.

I love it, compare to other products I used before from other brands this hyaluronic serum is much more quality, thicker, and I believe more result. Well, it is more pricey too. But that's what you pay for.
Bought this from Ogle Schools & can't say enough good things about it.
Love this- very hydrating and doesn't leave any oily or sticky residue like some serums do.
Love the Circular Hydration Serum! It is light yet helps hold the moisture into my skin creating a barrier. I use it morning and night and won't be without it. Thanks for such a great product! Claire

Light, fresh smell; goes on lightly and easily. !My face felt deeply moisturized but not heavy. Perfect to use alone or along with another moisturizer. My new favorite Dermalogica product! (And I've been a faithful customer for 30 year). Also, it shipped right away and arrived on time.

avis.titre: I wanted this to be part of my winter skincare…
avis.texte: Unfortunately, this serum caused my skin to be red and flaky. I really wanted to like it and I was hoping it would help keep my face hydrated through the harsh winters. The search continues…
Love it! I have dry skin. I was looking for a product to replace the skin hydrating serum since it was discontinued. I like this a lot better.
Absolutely love this serum. Pairs well with vitamin c and doesn't leave a tacky feel or irritate rosacea redness. I use it twice a day and my face is smoother and more hydrated.

I've been using for a few weeks. My skin was looking dry and it lacked luster. This has definitely given my skin a boost. It looks healthier. The applicator is easy to use. It goes on smooth. Doesn't leave skin sticky.
This product is good, but the sample is not the same. The formula in the sample is better, it feels more moisturized on your skin.

This serum has really helped the hydration level of my skin and also helped to improve my acne. I like how lightweight it is and how it feels when I apply it. I will continue to use this product in the future.
I've been using the serum for about 2 weeks now as the weather changes in Colorado. I can tell my face is more hydrated and isn't as dry. I also pair with the recommended moisturizer. Love it!

avis.titre: I liked it before they changed it ￼
avis.texte: They changed this serum, I'm not sure when but I loved the old one. This one has a scent to it now and it is still hydrating, but for some reason it made my whole face itch and anywhere I put it I was so itchy. I never have bad reactions so very strange, but I am returning.
This serum is amazing, it keeps my face moisture locked in. Making my skin feel fresh and appear smooth. Highly recommend it!
I've always had trouble holding moisture in my face but not now! I've had a number of people ask what's changed in my skin routine. Very happy with the serum!
I like it but I don't think it's as effective for me as the skin hydrating booster was. That said, I like this product. It goes on smoothly and is absorbed nicely.
I love this serum. Does what it's supposed to, really seals in the moisture.
Leaves my face sticky. All the serums leave my face sticky. So sorry I'm disappointed because I have used the product before. If I can send back I would like to. Thank you Eileen
I love this product!! Perfect way to begin my skin care regime in the morning. A little goes a long way, great product !!

I use it every morning after I clean my face.It takes just a drop to cover face and neck area. It's very light but feels very good on the skin. It is a great addition before using my regular moisturizer. Sometimes during the day if my skins feels a little dry I will use a drop to refresh my skin.
Keeps skin hydrated. I put them on my dry patches and skin gets a lot better!! Re purchased.

Since I've been using my new products, my eyes have been extremely irritated and I'm unable to wear my contacts. Not exactly sure what is causing this. So I have quit using products for a few days to see if it clears up and try again. My skin feels great but my eyes are not good.

I use this everyday as part of my skin care routine. I use it as a base under my moisturizer. I find that reduces my flaky dry skin all year round and especially during the winter months. I could not live without this product. I highly recommend if you have dry skin, especially in the T-zone.

Some products take awhile to show their benefits, not this one! After just one use I noticed my skin brighter, softer, and more hydrated. It's now an essential part of my daily routine. It is pricey and bottle is small, but worth it.
I've had sensitive dry skin my whole life, this product has been a game changer for me. It's incredible!
Love this serum! Hydrates my skin well, absorbs well and you see the difference. I live where weather is dry so my skin was vey thirsty before I started to use this.

I use this on wet skin (after spraying thermal water then my "star ingredient) and it keeps my skin so hydrated all day. The only thing is the smell. It's so off. Hasn't made me break out so I'll deal with the smell.
My skin looks healthy and less sun damage from too many beach days
Super light, and I started to see the difference almost immediately
I think this is the best product ever! I see a remarkable difference in the smoothness of my skin.
This serum is sooo hydrating! My skin feels amazing even hours later
I use this serum every night before I moisturize. It leaves my skin feeling hydrated and fresh. It is a must have in my skincare routine.
Received this as a complimentary gift with my order. My skin feels so plump and hydrated! Love love love! I definitely plan on purchasing.

avis.titre: Great product but glass bottle is fragile!
avis.texte: I have been using this for about a month and loved it until…..I opened by medicine cabinet and the bottle fell and shattered! So much lovely serum down the drain literally. I will buy it again but I would love to see a more durable bottle for it.
I've been using this for about 2 weeks. Seems to be making a difference. We live in dry CO and I was getting dry spots under my eyes which is why I bought this.
This was recommended to me by my aesthetician because of my very dry skin. Using this along with the Dermalogica moisturizer has improved my hydration level. It's easy to apply a few drops each day.
I first tried this as a sample and really liked the result. I use this after a toner most nights then follow with belif moisturizing bomb and my skin feels great.
the claims are real. I've been using this product for over 6 months & it keeps my skin very hydrated for an entire day.
I used this for a few months and noticed more bouncy glowy skin but had the worst breakouts. I do not have acne and had to stop using the product due to the bumps all over my face.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again.
avis.texte: This product keeps my skin hydrated and soft. This is the third time I have ordered. Does not irritate my skin and soaks in. No greasy residue.
I have very dry skin and just within the first two weeks have noticed a huge improvement in the moisture of my skin while using this product!
Love this product. I notice a difference within a day. Plumper skin, brightness. Second time buying this product.
I got this as a sample and love how refreshing it is. Works great under your normal moisturizer.

I am cautious to add new moisturizers and question how different really is this moisturizer, but this hydration serum is wonderful. It's so moisturizing and plumping. It's a game changer for sure. Definitely worth trying.
Just started using this serum, because I fell in love with other products from Dermalogica, so far, I definitely notice my skin hydration is awesome, beats other brand i used previously hands down!!!
This stuff is fantastic. I used to have dry patches on my face. The circular hydration serum along with exfoliating and now my face is smooth and no dry flakes.

Pros: Easy to apply, not irritating, absorbs quickly, didn't clog pores Cons: No change in wrinkles It softened my skin, but for the price, I expected more results. It's not a bad product, so it's worth a try.

avis.titre: circular hydration serum with hyaluronic acid
avis.texte: I like how refreshed my skin feels after I put on the serum. I also like how it remains hydrated for the next day. I like how I can add my moisturizer with SPF for the day and it doesn't feel too heavy.
I absolutely LOVE my new serum!! I can't wait to wash my face!!
I love this product!! My skin looks smooth, plump and hydrated! It's great base before moisturizer.
